preservation.scope: all COPY table data present in the native archive; omitted source objects are not covered

behaviour: Retains exact Slack unavailable-message markers and immutable source versions.
Prevents old content reappearing through ordinary reads, derived context or scoring.
Available replies remain independently eligible; unavailable counts are separate from conversation counts.
Tenant and operator authority remain unchanged.
limits: Hosted schema/runtime/frontend release and provider-page continuation are not yet verified.
Already published card summaries without per-field lineage require explicit reconciliation; the page fails atomically before ingestion.
Restoration of withheld content remains an explicit future reviewed action.
No DMs, private-channel expansion, downloads or new credential access.
